p.s: First i would like to say that life does not stop at acertian age, so i have to disagree with this statment.

But also i must say that there are somethings that old people cant do anymore, never the less there are even more thing they still can do, as long as the person is surounded by his loved ones, have a good hobby or still knows how to life in the eyes of his children he 'll always enjoy life.
A young person could enjoy the things that the old persons had already enjoyed.
For young people a need for exploring, for going to places, for speeding from time to time, for there heart beatting faster and faster as they start to feel love in thier souls is a must.
For old people they 've seen it all - or at least thats whats they 're saying - they want the quit nights, the early sleep, the healthy food, and a vacation to an island that he always dreamed of.

For example a night of playing pingo with your friends and wife, going fishing with the child of your sun or going from time to time to your old work, all these things would mean the joy for an old person.

Where a young man or girl would feel bored if he / she had to do any of these things everyweek, he would rather be in a party or with his girl, or playing a hard game like football or basketball, she would rather be in the mall getting ready for the pram.
And in the other hand the life of young people is not suitable for old people, to party every time you could, to play and move all the time.
So every age has its own style, its own magic, its own ENJOY.
